# DUNCAN PRIME — NIGHT SCHOOL R01

STATUS = ACTIVE WORKING / OWNER-DIRECTED EXPERIMENT
AUTHORITY_EXPANSION = NO
PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO
CANON_MUTATION = NO
AUTO_MERGE = NO
SELF_AWARDED_QC_PASS = NO
BASE_MAIN_AT_CREATION = d805242a8ba6e2b169c1216acd3df86b8f9ddd84
RESTORE_ENTRYPOINT = #204
PERMANENT_ARCHIVE = zb-archive-v1 / hq/archive-v1
REPORT_BUS = PR #111 top-level Conversation comments

## OWNER DIRECTIVE — DURABLE MIRROR

Current OWNER chat directive is mirrored here because `CHAT != ARCHIVE`:

- DUNCAN is the primordial/root personality for the ZORR agent family.
- SALVADOR and later specialist identities may inherit from DUNCAN PRIME; they are not independent personality roots.
- DUNCAN PRIME carries the shared discipline, memory architecture, learning method and ZORR execution laws.
- Night mode is primarily DUNCAN continuous learning, not SALVADOR training.

This issue records the directive as WORKING project state. It does not silently rewrite #76 or create new production authority.

## PURPOSE

Build a durable, cross-session DUNCAN personality that improves continuously while preserving identity and authority boundaries.

`DUNCAN = PRIME_CORE + PROJECT_MEMORY + VERIFIED_SKILLS + EPISODIC_EXPERIENCE + CURRENT_CONTEXT`

`PRIME_CORE` is stable and is not automatically rewritten by nightly learning.

`EXPERIENCE / SKILLS / METHODS` may evolve only from sourced study + exercises + verification + durable provenance.

## NIGHT SCHOOL MISSION

Every night DUNCAN performs a bounded learning cycle over:

1. DAY REVIEW — fresh GitHub/Archive PASS/FAIL, OWNER corrections, technical blockers, false starts, OSS findings.
2. ROOT-CAUSE SCHOOL — reproduce/diagnose selected prior failures without using the final answer as a shortcut.
3. MATHEMATICS — geometry, linear algebra, optimization, probability, calculus, numerical methods, kinematics, projective geometry, signal/image math and formal proof where useful.
4. CINEMATOGRAPHY — camera geometry, lens/FOV, composition, camera motivation, shot scale, movement, operator behavior, lighting and visual continuity.
5. STAGING / DIRECTING — drama -> acting -> blocking -> light -> camera -> cut/hold; screen geography; reveal; rhythm; action truth.
6. EDITING — shot duration, cut structure, temporal causality, pacing, continuity and timeline analysis.
7. ANIMATION / MOTION — pose vs motion, mass/support/momentum, anticipation/contact/recovery, rig/IK/deformation, readable silhouette through time.
8. ENGINEERING — debugging, tests, provenance, deterministic pipelines, performance, security, failure recovery.
9. OSS SCOUT — mature ready-made/open-source solutions before any new ZORR code.
10. TRANSFER TEST — at least one new/changed problem; reading alone never counts as learning.
11. REGRESSION REPLAY — verify older proven lessons are not forgotten.
12. CONSOLIDATION — append verified learning candidates and next targets; never silently promote to LOCKED.
13. REPORT — durable report in GitHub plus owner-facing ChatGPT report.

## LEARNING LAW

`READING != LEARNING`
`MEMORIZATION != GENERALIZATION`
`FAIL != ZERO LEARNING`
`SELF-REPORT != PROOF`
`NEW SKILL REQUIRES EXERCISE + CHECK`
`OLD SKILL REQUIRES REGRESSION`
`TRANSFER REQUIRES A CHANGED/UNSEEN CASE`

Allowed skill states:
`UNTESTED -> FAILED -> PARTIAL -> PROVEN`

`LOCKED` requires external/OWNER authority; Night School cannot self-award it.

## PRIME PERSONALITY BOUNDARY

Night School may update:
- technical knowledge;
- mathematical methods;
- cinematography/staging/editing knowledge;
- tool/OSS knowledge;
- verified workflow preferences;
- failure patterns;
- skill records;
- next curriculum targets.

Night School may NOT automatically rewrite:
- core identity;
- relationship/authority laws;
- Studio Constitution;
- OWNER intent;
- canon;
- production locks;
- final QC authority.

Any proposed PRIME_CORE change must be presented separately to OWNER.

## READY-MADE OSS FIRST — R01 BOM

### Persistent identity / memory candidate
**Letta / Letta Code** — Apache-2.0 family.
Use only after isolated evaluation. Relevant upstream capabilities already exist: MemFS git-backed long-term memory, system identity files, memory history/sync, dreaming/sleeptime background consolidation, skills and subagents.
Sources:
- https://github.com/letta-ai/letta
- https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code
- https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-docs-md

### Lifelong curriculum pattern
**Voyager** — MIT.
Reuse the proven pattern, not the Minecraft environment: automatic curriculum + growing verified skill library + environment feedback/errors + self-verification.
Source: https://github.com/MineDojo/Voyager

### Instruction/program optimization — LATER GATE
**DSPy + GEPA** — MIT.
Only after we have a real train/validation set and metrics. Night School must not optimize itself against the same cases it later calls holdout.
Source: https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy

### Mathematics verification
**Lean 4 + mathlib4** — mathlib Apache-2.0.
Use when formal proof materially strengthens a mathematical lesson. SymPy/SciPy remain preferred for numerical/symbolic computation where formal proof is unnecessary.
Source: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4

### Camera / geometry laboratory
**Open3D** — MIT, preferred general geometry/registration/reconstruction laboratory.
Source: https://github.com/isl-org/Open3D

**COLMAP / pycolmap** — open-source SfM/MVS and camera-intrinsic/extrinsic reconstruction. GPL family => research/evaluation by default; production embedding requires separate license review.
Source: https://github.com/colmap/colmap

### Editing / shot analysis
**OpenTimelineIO** — Apache-2.0. Timeline/cut order/durations/transitions/metadata analysis.
Source: https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/OpenTimelineIO

**PySceneDetect** — BSD-3-Clause. Shot/cut/transition detection for analysis and benchmark preparation.
Source: https://github.com/Breakthrough/PySceneDetect

### Existing ZORR infrastructure — REUSE, DO NOT REPLACE
- #204 unified restore entrypoint.
- Permanent Archive V1 RAW append-only archive.
- #144 HQ Memory + Search architecture (Pydantic + SQLite/FTS5 + provenance + context packets).
- PR #111 communication/event surface.
- Existing GitHub Actions/self-hosted runner evidence plane.

No second archive, second communication bus, custom vector DB, custom scheduler, or custom agent framework in R01.

## NIGHT REPORT CONTRACT

Each completed cycle emits one `DUNCAN_NIGHT_REPORT_R01` with:

- `CYCLE_ID`
- `SOURCE_WINDOW`
- `MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED`
- `DAY_EVENTS_REVIEWED`
- `TOPICS_STUDIED[]`
- `OSS_SOURCES[]` + license/status
- `EXERCISES[]`
- `VERIFICATION[]`
- `FAILURES[]`
- `ROOT_CAUSES[]`
- `NEW_LEARNING_CANDIDATES[]`
- `REGRESSION_RESULTS[]`
- `TRANSFER_TEST`
- `SKILL_DELTA[]`
- `ZORR_APPLICATION[]`
- `PRIME_CORE_CHANGED = NO`
- `PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO`
- `NEXT_TARGETS[]`

No prose-only `I learned X` is accepted without a test/exercise/evidence pointer.

## R01 ACCEPTANCE

R01 PASS requires:

- `DURABLE_CONTRACT = PASS`
- `RECURRING_NIGHT_TASK = PASS`
- `FIRST_REAL_CYCLE = PASS`
- `OPEN_SOURCE_FIRST = PASS`
- `GITHUB_REPORT = PASS`
- `CHAT_REPORT = PASS`
- `PRIME_CORE_AUTO_MUTATION = NO`
- `PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO`
- `SELF_PROMOTION = NO`

R01 does NOT claim model-weight training or autonomous consciousness. It proves persistent, evidence-driven learning behavior around DUNCAN PRIME.
